title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28703v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-scale topology optimization (TO) remains computationally demanding, especially for stress-constrained problems. To address this challenge, we propose the simultaneous neural topology optimization (SNTO) framework where we represent state, adjoint, and design variables with custom neural networks (NNs) whose parameters are jointly optimized within a single optimization loop that leverages continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation. This optimization minimizes a multi-component loss function that combines the design objective, an aggregation of the local stress constraints, and the potential energy functionals. Our NNs have a unique architecture that accelerates convergence while enabling the networks to capture sharp gradients and boundaries which are critical to stress-constrained TO. tldr: 提出同步神经拓扑优化（SNTO）框架，利用自定义神经网络在单一优化循环中联合表示并优化状态、伴随和设计变量，配合独特的网络架构与硬件感知训练方案，实现了面向数百万自由度的可扩展应力约束拓扑优化。
en_tdlr: The proposed SNTO framework jointly optimizes state, adjoint, and design variables represented by custom neural networks within a single optimization loop, using a unique network architecture and hardware-aware training scheme to achieve scalable stress-constrained topology optimization at millions of degrees of freedom.
